notes: This contract pins Umbra's opt-in, non-installable no-TSO Query GALT and Query LITS slice to source-derived IEEE 1516.1-2025 records. It calculates bounds only from other time-regulating members' current or pending-advance time plus actual lookahead; a forward TAR from a zero-lookahead regulator makes that lower timestamp exclusive, so the calculator advances it by the selected factory's epsilon. Within this no-TSO calculator slice, LITS equals a defined GALT and both are undefined with no other regulator. A separate limited scheduler consumes these bounds and the NRG setting for TAR release; the calculator itself does not queue callbacks. It does not cover the private TSO message inputs, TSO delivery, asynchronous delivery, the separately traced Modify Lookahead service, save/restore, package support, catalog result, JUnit sidecar, protected review, or a conformance claim.
